title: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Cherry Cola 10ml E-Liquid
description: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Cherry Cola combines the rich, fruity sweetness of Cherry with the familiar, tangy notes of classic Cola. The result is a bold and fizzy vape with that’s familiar and nostalgic, balancing deep fruitiness with a bubbly soda finish. Designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, this nicotine salt e-liquid ensures a consistently satisfying throat hit with optimised nicotine absorption. The 50/50 VG/PG ratio enhances flavour clarity while maintaining discreet vapour production, making it an excellent choice for pod kits and vape starter kits. Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ e-liquids provide a cost-effective and sustainable alternative to single-use disposable vapes, offering popular flavours in a refillable format. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, each bottle features a childproof cap and an easy-fill nozzle for convenience.
